newsitem.title: ITALY: Italy August used car market shows hint of upturn.
newsitem.headline: Italy August used car market shows hint of upturn.

text.p: Italy's used car market showed a slight sign of improvement in August but the market remains frail, auto forecasting body Centro Studi Promotor (CSP) said.
In its latest survey, CSP said only 60 percent of dealers said sales were low in August, a slight improvement on 63 percent surveyed in July and 64 percent in June.
Some 52 percent saw prices in the next quarter remaining stable, while 35 percent said they would fall and only 13 percent forecast a rise.
